title: Application of Western Massachsuetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Comany's tariff, M.D.P.U. 476, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's cusotmers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of March, April and May, 1985. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company, and Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 477. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilties with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 210 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
